variables.name: NEO4J_URI
variables.title: Neo4j URI
variables.description: Bolt URI for the Neo4j instance (e.g. neo4j+s://<dbid>.databases.neo4j.io or bolt://localhost:7687).

variables.name: NEO4J_READ_ONLY
variables.title: Read-Only Mode
variables.description: Set to true to disable write operations (default: true).

variables.name: NEO4J_LOG_LEVEL
variables.title: Log Level
variables.description: Logging level for the MCP server (e.g. info, debug, warn, error).

variables.name: NEO4J_LOG_FORMAT
variables.title: Log Format
variables.description: Output format for server logs (e.g. text, json).

variables.name: NEO4J_SCHEMA_SAMPLE_SIZE
variables.title: Schema Sample Size
variables.description: Number of nodes/relationships sampled during schema introspection (default: 100).
